h1: Rank #1 as a recruitment company: Industry-Specific SEO That Converts
intro: Marketing a recruitment company is nothing like marketing a generic local business. Your clients research carefully, compare options, and trust signals matter more than slogans. Retained versus contingency search pages attract employers with different budgets. Salary guides and market reports earn links from HR blogs and publications. Niche specialization pages for tech or finance win higher-fee placements. Candidate testimonials build the trust employers need before sharing openings. With industry-specific SEO, your recruitment company can own the searches that matter instead of fighting for scraps. Local SEO is a long game, but every month of consistent work compounds: better rankings bring more calls, more calls bring more reviews, and more reviews push rankings higher still. Businesses that commit to the process pull away from competitors that dabble.
